findings.title: priority field is not documented in api.md
findings.description: The create endpoint now accepts a priority field but api.md does not mention it. Callers have no way to know valid values or default behaviour.
findings.evidence: api.md POST /items section lists only: title, description. No mention of priority.
findings.recommendation: Add a priority field entry to the POST /items request body table in api.md, including accepted values and the default.

limitations: Only files listed in context.json relevantDocs were reviewed.
